VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 31 tests pass and describes the fix implemented, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. Self-reports are inherently unreliable for verification purposes, as they cannot be independently validated. To satisfy the acceptance criteria, objective evidence such as passing CI test results or code review artifacts would be required.
